provenance.source_title: How Did Ancient Humans Survive Freezing Winters

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒给出精确年代锚点并把观众指派为绝境中的当事人
examples.expression_mechanism: 时间锚点 + 第二人称身份指派的零铺垫沉浸开场
examples.example_text: Imagine it's 40,000 years ago, somewhere in what's now Northern Europe, and you're huddled in the mouth of a cave
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"具体年代 + 你就在现场"一句话完成沉浸与定位
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该年代、地点与场景设定

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代便利的缺席排比反衬绝境的真实重量，笑点与紧张同步
examples.expression_mechanism: no X, no Y, no Z 三连否定排比
examples.example_text: no thermostat to adjust, no heated blanket, no delivery app to order soup from.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习列举观众习以为常的便利并一键全部抽走，让危险变得具体
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该便利清单；排比项必须与目标主题的绝境直接相关

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个出人意料的证据来源制造"这也能知道"的顿悟高峰
examples.expression_mechanism: 先否定想当然的证据形态，再揭晓荒诞却真实的来源
examples.example_text: And we know this not because someone found a perfectly preserved parka in a glacier, but because of an unexpected source, lice. Yes, lice.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习"不是因为A而是因为意想不到的B"的证据揭示句式，并用单词重复定格惊讶
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该证据本身；意外来源必须真实支撑结论

examples.psychological_goal: 把工艺细节提炼为一句可迁移的底层原理，并嫁接现代对应物
examples.expression_mechanism: 原理一句话提炼 + 现代产品原理对照
examples.example_text: It was about trapping air efficiently. The exact same principle modern insulated jackets rely on today.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在细节清单之后用一句原理收束，并立刻指出它在现代世界的同款应用
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该原理表述；提炼必须真的能统摄前文细节

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代装备类比为史前发明完成笑点与记忆点定性
examples.expression_mechanism: the ancient equivalent of [现代物件] minus [现代便利] 的类比公式
examples.example_text: Essentially inventing the ancient equivalent of a snow boot with built-in wool socks, minus the convenience of a shoe store.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习"古代版X，减去便利Y"的类比公式为抽象工艺一秒定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比对象；现代参照必须与机制同构

examples.psychological_goal: 用拟人化晋升宣告新章节主角，完成叙事轨道切换
examples.expression_mechanism: [资源] becomes the true main character 的拟人化晋升句
examples.example_text: Fire, unsurprisingly, becomes the true main character of this story.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句话把非人物对象立为"主角"，让章节切换有仪式感
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用该句式；晋升对象必须是后文真正展开的核心

examples.psychological_goal: 揭示资源维护行为意外催生出的社会结构
examples.expression_mechanism: 研究者口径假说 + essentially an early version of [现代制度] 溯源
examples.example_text: essentially an early version of shift work requiring cooperation, trust, and communication between group members.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把远古行为溯源为现代制度的"早期版本"，并用三连名词收尾
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该制度类比；假说必须保持研究者口径

examples.psychological_goal: 把现代习惯溯源回远古场景，制造温柔的错位笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: modern love for [日常行为] trace roots back to [远古场景]
examples.example_text: some anthropologists believe our modern love for gathering around campfires, sharing meals, or even just watching a screen together on a couch
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用三连日常行为排比把现代习惯接到远古根源上
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该行为清单；溯源关系需有真实依据

examples.psychological_goal: 把生存策略连接到物种级演化红利，抬高叙事 stakes
examples.expression_mechanism: 研究者口径 + 第二层收益连接到更大议题
examples.example_text: access to cooked food during increasingly cold resource scarce periods played a meaningful role in supporting the higher energy demands of larger human brains
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把一个具体操作连接到意想不到的宏观后果，一句话放大意义
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该因果链；宏观连接必须标注假说性质

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句定性把统计 pattern 升级为物理必然
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定巧合 + 抬出底层学科的两句式断言
examples.example_text: This isn't a coincidence. It's basic thermodynamics playing out in bone structure.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习"这不是巧合，这是X在起作用"的两句式，把观察升级为原理
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该学科指向；底层解释必须真实成立

examples.psychological_goal: 用家电类比把抽象生理机制瞬间讲透并制造笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: functioning like an internal [家用电器] built right into your body
examples.example_text: It actively burns energy to generate heat, essentially functioning like an internal space heater built right into your body.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把身体机制类比成内置家电，让听众用直觉理解原理
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该家电类比；类比的功能映射必须准确

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众以为的"烦人缺陷"反转为精妙设计
examples.expression_mechanism: 大众认知陈述 + but 反转 + 高效机制定性
examples.example_text: something most people think of as just an annoying involuntary reaction, but it's actually a highly efficient survival mechanism
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先替观众说出轻视性认知，再用一句反转完成重新定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该机制内容；反转必须基于真实功能

examples.psychological_goal: 完成"致命环境反过来成为工具"的世界观反转
examples.expression_mechanism: the very [想伤害你的东西] + turning it into [解决方案]
examples.example_text: taking advantage of the very environment trying to kill them and turning it into a storage solution instead.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"正是那个想杀死你的东西"句式把威胁反转为资源
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该情境；反转对象必须与前文威胁同一

examples.psychological_goal: 给"独自硬扛"的浪漫想象判死刑，确立协作主题
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定句定性 + 极端后果比喻收束
examples.example_text: Surviving brutal winters wasn't a solo mission, and honestly, trying to do it alone would have been close to a death sentence.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"这不是单人任务"+极端后果比喻为协作价值定调
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比喻；后果定性需有前文证据支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用具象材料与尺度对比展示住所工程的惊人成熟度
examples.expression_mechanism: 建材白描 + essentially building + 结构定性
examples.example_text: constructed shelters using mammoth bones as structural framework, then covered them with hide for insulation, essentially building freestanding, semi-permanent winter homes
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先白描材料与做法，再用现代工程词汇为建筑定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该建材与场景；定性词必须与细节匹配

examples.psychological_goal: 用"很少有人想到"开启新维度，为非物质章节造势
examples.expression_mechanism: something people rarely consider + 新维度名词点题
examples.example_text: Let's shift focus for a moment to something people rarely consider when picturing ancient winter survival. Mental resilience and knowledge transfer.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"人们很少想到X"句式开启一个隐性维度章节
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用；新维度必须确实是前文未覆盖的盲区

examples.psychological_goal: 直白承认失败与代价，以诚实换取全片可信度
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定成功必然性 + 拒绝美化包装的自我声明
examples.example_text: Of course, not every winter survival attempt succeeded, and it's worth acknowledging that plainly rather than painting an overly rosy picture.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在高潮后主动插入诚实段：承认失败并声明拒绝美化
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该措辞；诚实段必须有真实证据跟进

examples.psychological_goal: 用"你与灾难之间隔着一整套隐形遗产"完成现代回扣的情绪峰值
examples.expression_mechanism: 隐形系统清单 + stands between you and [灾难] 的栅栏句式
examples.example_text: how much invisible engineering, biological adaptation, and hard-earned communal knowledge stands between you and a freezing death every single winter
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把全部前文机制打包成"站在你和X之间"的一句话总结
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该清单与灾难对象；打包必须覆盖前文主线

examples.psychological_goal: 用系统定性句否定"单一巧招"的简化想象，完成主题升维
examples.expression_mechanism: wasn't a single [巧招] + It was an ongoing evolving system built from [四元清单]
examples.example_text: Surviving winter wasn't a single clever trick pulled off once. It was an ongoing evolving system built from biology, engineering, community, and accumulated knowledge
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾先否定单一解释，再用多元清单把主题升级为系统
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该清单；系统组件必须与前文章节一一对应

examples.psychological_goal: 以"你的存在本身就是证据"的格言式定性完成情绪封顶
examples.expression_mechanism: 祖先幸存事实 +  quietly impressive + 物种级最高级定性
examples.example_text: might be one of the most quietly impressive survival stories our species has ever pulled Off.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾把观众的存在本身写成论据，并用克制的最高级定性收束
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该定性句；最高级必须有全片事实支撑
